Riyadh, Saudi Arabia — During the first day of LEAP 2026, Saudi telecom operator Mobily and global technology leader Nokia signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to accelerate the transition towards smarter, more efficient, and sustainable networks. The strategic partnership focuses on deploying artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to enhance the performance and efficiency of wireless networks, marking a significant step in modernizing the Kingdom's telecommunications infrastructure [1].

The agreement between Mobily and Nokia sets a foundation for exploring new AI-supported use cases and services within the telecommunications sector. By leveraging advanced AI capabilities, the two companies aim to optimize network resource utilization and promote operational sustainability. This collaboration is designed to improve the overall customer experience by ensuring more reliable and efficient network performance across Saudi Arabia [2]. Furthermore, the integration of these advanced systems into the existing framework is expected to yield substantial long-term benefits. By prioritizing the optimization of network resources, Mobily and its partners can ensure that the infrastructure remains robust and capable of handling future demands. This proactive approach to network management is essential as digital connectivity forms the backbone of economic and social activities. The emphasis on operational sustainability also reflects a growing awareness of the need to balance technological progress with environmental responsibility. As these initiatives unfold, they will undoubtedly set new standards for the industry, encouraging other players to adopt similar strategies.

## Future Prospects and Industry Impact

While the MoU establishes a clear framework for collaboration, the practical implementation of these AI-supported use cases will require ongoing effort and investment. The telecommunications sector is highly competitive, and the successful deployment of these technologies will be critical for Mobily to maintain its market leadership. The partnership with Nokia provides a strong foundation, but the true measure of success will be seen in the tangible improvements to network performance and customer satisfaction.

Looking ahead, the telecommunications industry in Saudi Arabia and the broader MENA region will likely see further investments in AI and machine learning technologies. The Mobily-Nokia partnership serves as a benchmark for how telecom operators can leverage global expertise to enhance their domestic infrastructure. As these technologies mature, the potential for new, innovative services that further transform the digital landscape remains vast.
